description: Defines the VaapiVideoEncoderDelegate class and related structures for hardware-accelerated video encoding using VA-API, including encode job management, configuration, and resource handling.

classes.name: VaapiVideoEncoderDelegate
classes.description: Manages high-level, platform-independent encoding tasks, resource management, and interaction with hardware accelerators for VA-API video encoding.

classes.name: EncodeResult
classes.description: Represents the result of an encoding operation, owning the encoded buffer and associated metadata.

classes.name: EncodeJob
classes.description: Abstracts an encode task for a single video frame, including setup parameters and resource management.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the encoder with specified configuration parameters.

methods.name: UpdateRates
methods.description: Updates the encoder's framerate and bitrate settings.

methods.name: GetCodedSize
methods.description: Returns the required coded size for input buffers.

methods.name: GetBitstreamBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the minimum size in bytes for output bitstream buffers.

methods.name: GetMaxNumOfRefFrames
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of reference frames supported.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Prepares and submits an encode job to the hardware driver.

methods.name: GetEncodeResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of an encode operation, synchronizing as needed.

methods.name: GetSVCLayerResolutions
methods.description: Returns active spatial layer resolutions for scalable video coding.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Generates metadata for a given encode job.

methods.name: PrepareEncodeJob
methods.description: Prepares an encode job for execution in the hardware accelerator.

methods.name: BitrateControlUpdate
methods.description: Updates bitrate control parameters based on encoded data.
